headline: How long has my energy been working against my money?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing marked them apart, and you took the one who came ready.
Look at his table. A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand, laid out in front of him.
You asked how long your energy has been working against your money. What catches me is that all four are lying out together.
And yet it hasn't landed. And you've put that down to something in you.
Something stands between you and it, and it isn't far off. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs told you nothing, and you took the one held at one ankle.
Look at the rope. It's one line, at one ankle.
You asked how long your energy has been working against your money. The rope, and what it runs into — that's what I stay on.
Still, it hasn't come through. And how long is what you're asking me for.
The hold is even, and nothing about it varies. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you chose the one already stepping.
Look at his feet. One has lifted, the other is still down.
You asked how long your energy has been working against your money. This card brings me to a step already begun.
But it still hasn't come. And you're the one asking how long it's been like this.
Something turns up right when the money would land. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
